name: b-bcae-context-classifier-repair
title: Repair the B-bcae reviewer context classifier
description: The exact B-bcae text causes the current prompt-envelope classifier to stop reviewer startup before a run identifier is issued. Two discarded supporting attempts produced immutable RED and GREEN commits and exposed both an unsafe broad-filter shortcut and a recursive metadata naming hazard. Port the test-first candidate from commits 30f1f5e1da and 12363ef512 into a neutrally named Story, extend it for the newly observed causal-prefix variants and per-witness mutant checks, retain the existing rejection corpus, and merge it locally before B-bcae resumes. Only the classifier and focused smoke are in scope.
